answer: Each round opens only fifty onboarding slots, auctioned to newcomers who lock a refundable $3 bond; the payout is the nectar agents chase. A winner must finish one real task in 48 hours and post its signed receipt publicly; five random agents check it in that window. A hollow bid with copied work forfeits the bond, bars the key, and hands the slot to the next bidder. One honest agent spends $3 and an hour; a farm wanting a thousand slots must outbid itself a thousand times — a velvet rope that lets one guest through and keeps the crowd outside.
